daysBack.title: Filed in the last (days)
daysBack.description: How far back to look. Companies must file Form D within 15 days of their first sale, so the last 7 days is the freshest view of who just raised.

companyType.title: Companies or funds
companyType.description: About 6 in 10 Form D filings are investment funds (VC, private equity, hedge and real-estate funds). They are left out by default so you get operating companies.

sectors.title: Sectors
sectors.description: Only companies in these sectors, as the company chose on the form. Leave empty for all.

states.title: States
states.description: Only companies whose business address is in these US states (two-letter codes). Leave empty for everywhere, including companies abroad.

minAmountRaised.title: Minimum amount raised (USD)
minAmountRaised.description: Only filings reporting at least this much already sold in the round, e.g. 1000000.

minOfferingAmount.title: Minimum round size (USD)
minOfferingAmount.description: Only rounds whose stated target is at least this much. Rounds with no fixed size ("indefinite") are kept.

incorporatedWithinYears.title: Founded within (years)
incorporatedWithinYears.description: Only young companies: incorporated in the last N years. Good for finding startups.

companyKeywords.title: Company name contains
companyKeywords.description: Only companies whose name contains one of these, e.g. "AI", "Therapeutics", "Labs".

includeAmendments.title: Include amendments
includeAmendments.description: Also return Form D/A filings: yearly renewals and corrections of an earlier notice. Off by default, so you see new raises.

latestPerCompany.title: One row per company
latestPerCompany.description: When a company filed more than once in the period, return only its newest filing.

onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Only filings new since this search last ran
onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: For scheduled runs: skip every filing this same search has already delivered, so you never pay twice for the same company. The Actor remembers each search in a key-value store named form-d-funding-monitor in your account; changing any filter (other than the date range) starts a new history.

monitorName.title: Search name (optional)
monitorName.description: Only needed to keep two searches with identical filters separate, e.g. one per client.

filedFrom.title: From date (optional)
filedFrom.description: An exact start date, YYYY-MM-DD, instead of 'Filed in the last (days)'. SEC search covers filings from 2001 onwards.

filedTo.title: To date (optional)
filedTo.description: An exact end date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Hard cap on results for the whole run, and your main cost control: you are charged per filing returned. Newest filings come first.
